This avoids the security risks of using the built-in eval(). """ # Supported operators operators = { ast.Add: operator.add, ast.Sub: operator.sub, ast.Mult: operator.mul, ast.Div: operator.truediv, ast.Pow: operator.pow, ast.USub: operator.neg, } def eval_(node, depth): # Resource Exhaustion: Prevent deep recursion/nested expressions if depth > 100: raise RecursionError("Expression too complex") if isinstance(node, ast.Num): # < Python 3.8 return node.n elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant): # Python 3.8+ if not isinstance(node.value, (int, float)): raise TypeError("Unsupported constant type") return node.value elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp): op_type = type(node.op) if op_type in operators: left = eval_(node.left, depth + 1) right = eval_(node.right, depth + 1) # Resource Exhaustion: Prevent CPU exhaustion from massive exponents if op_type == ast.Pow: if not isinstance(left, (int, float)) or not isinstance(right, (int, float)): raise TypeError("Pow requires numbers") if abs(left) > 1e10 or abs(right) > 1000: raise ValueError("Exponent too large") return operators[op_type](left, right) else: raise TypeError(f"Unsupported operator: {op_type}") elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp): op_type = type(node.op) if op_type in operators: operand = eval_(node.operand, depth + 1) return operators[op_type](operand) else: raise TypeError(f"Unsupported operator: {op_type}") else: raise TypeError(f"Unsupported expression element: {type(node)}") try: # Parse the expression into an AST. # mode='eval' ensures only a single expression is parsed, not statements. tree = ast.parse(expr, mode='eval') return eval_(tree.body, 0) except Exception as e: raise e @app.post("/calculator", response_model=CalculationResponse) async def calculate(request: CalculationRequest): try: # Resource Exhaustion: Bound the input string length to prevent DoS via huge strings if len(request.expression) > 1000: raise ValueError("Expression too long") # Evaluate the expression safely res = safe_eval(request.expression) # Convert result to string as per OpenAPI schema example return CalculationResponse(result=str(res)) except (SyntaxError, TypeError, ValueError, RecursionError, ZeroDivisionError, OverflowError): # Error handling: Catch specific exceptions and return documented 400 status code # without leaking internal stack traces. raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") except Exception: # Generic catch-all to ensure no internal details leak raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") if __name__ == "__main__": # Start the server on port 5000 and host 0.0.0.0 uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
